title: The Thorium Molten-Salt Reactor: Why Didn't This Happen (and why is now the right time?)
summary: Kirk Sorensen's Google Tech Talk on thorium molten-salt reactors (LFTR). He covers why the technology was shelved after early development and argues that now is the right time to revisit it.
why: Recommended as the go-to pitch for liquid fluoride thorium reactors whenever nuclear power comes up.

quote.text: Kirk Sorensen has been a major advocate of molten-salt reactors and gave a great Google tech talk on the subject.
